siesta.note: The spine: the whole rest interval, then act, then speak. Every hub spoke in turn (the hub hides each once taken), Veran pressed on the geometry, Chorik drawn out (-> chorik_unguarded, which unlocks Aftermath's gated 'Speak up'), watch the circle, then wait the interval out, move on the housing, and say something true. Longest thread; weave it first so the shared opening beats are in place for the others.
path: Check in on the quiet one

silence.note: The same full siesta, but leave Chorik alone rather than drawing him out, and then say nothing in the aftermath. Covers Chorik's 'Let him be' and Aftermath's 'Walk away without speaking'. Carries the full tour deliberately: the ending lands harder woven against a PC who spent the whole interval with them.
path: Check in on the quiet one

withdraw.note: Full siesta, wait the interval out, then get clear of the pylon when it goes live instead of moving on the housing. Covers Completion's 'Get clear of the pylon'.
path: Check in on the quiet one

leave.note: Full siesta, then decide the work site is not your concern and walk before the interval ends (-> flee_dungeon). Covers The Rest Interval's 'Walk off the work site'.
path: Check in on the quiet one

roadside.note: The off-ramp at the road: decline the tea and keep walking (-> flee_dungeon). Covers Start's 'Walk on', which nothing else reaches.
